title: Uhlmann Pac-Systeme | LinkedIn
content:
Overview:
Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG is a leading global systems supplier for the packaging of pharmaceutical products in blisters, bottles, and cartons. The company offers flexible integral solutions that meet the challenges of international pharmaceutical companies, generics manufacturers, and contract packers. These include ever higher demands on reliability and cost efficiency, as well as product traceability, which is mandatory in many countries. On the basis of its innovative portfolio, including blister machines, bottle lines, cartoners, and end-of-line packaging machines, Uhlmann has been setting standards in terms of quality, efficiency, and availability for decades. Over time, the company has become a total solution provider: 360° PHARMA PACKAGING stands for consultation, project management, implementation, comprehensive services and digital solutions from a single source. The company, headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, operates worldwide and guarantees close support through twenty sales and services bases. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG was established in 1948 and is part of the Uhlmann Group, which is in its third generation of family management. The Group has a workforce of around 2,500 and generated sales amounting to EUR 504 million in the business year 2024/25. Further members of the Uhlmann Group are the companies Koch Pac-Systeme and Goldfuß Engineering in Germany, Cremer Speciaalmachines in the Netherlands, Axito in Poland, and Wonder Packing Machinery in China. As of October 2019, appropriate elements of central functions are pooled in the newly formed Uhlmann Group Holding GmbH & Co. KG. title: Uhlmann Pac-Systeme - CNBC
content: Family Affair: Rise of the Mittelstand. # Uhlmann Pac-Systeme. Uhlmann Pac-Systeme GmbH & Co. KG. Specializing in pharmaceutical packaging for more than 60 years, southern Germany based Uhlmann employs roughly 1,600 people worldwide and has a presence everywhere from Brazil to Singapore. Founded in 1948 by Josef Uhlmann, the company started out by manufacturing "precision molds for the production of suppositories." Eight years later, Uhlmann designed the HS30, described by the company as the "world's first universal strip packaging machine.". Friedrich Uhlmann, Josef's son, joined the company in 1963. In 2007, Tobias Uhlmann - the third generation of the Uhlmann family to be involved with the company - became chairman of the supervisory board of the Uhlmann Group, which reported a turnover of 260 million euros for 2013/14. title: Uhlmann India expands its footprint with new facility and Pharmazing India Days - Pharma Machines & Technology
content: ## On October 16, 2024, Uhlmann India inaugurated its new facility in Chakan MIDC Phase II, Pune, marking a pivotal step in the company’s commitment to the Indian pharmaceutical market. The inauguration event, titled “Pharmazing India Days 2024,” gathered industry leaders, partners, and customers to celebrate Uhlmann’s contributions to pharmaceutical packaging solutions and localization efforts, with presentations on advancements in blister packaging technology and the company’s vision for regional growth. Founded in 1948 in Laupheim, Germany, Uhlmann has established itself as a leading global supplier of packaging solutions for the pharmaceutical, FMCG, medical device, and cosmetics industries. “We’ve come a long way from a small, family-owned company in southern Germany to one of the largest players in pharmaceutical packaging worldwide,” said Sumeet Arora, Managing Director of Uhlmann India. With a focus on innovation, localization, and collaboration, Uhlmann India is poised to lead in the pharmaceutical packaging sector, ensuring that clients in India and beyond experience the best in blister, bottle, and carton packaging technology.
